ios.desc:
Turn Your Voice Into Organised Notes - Completely Offline
Note to Self is the privacy-first voice recording app that transforms speech into intelligent, searchable notes using powerful on-device AI. Record, transcribe, and organise your thoughts without ever sending data to external servers.


Key Features:
- Press & Hold Recording - Intuitive interface with haptic feedback
- Offline AI Transcription - Multilingual speech recognition 
- Smart Organisation - Automatic title generation and intelligent tagging, all editable after generation.
- Complete Privacy - All processing happens on your device
- Export & Import - ZIP-based data portability with conflict resolution

True Offline Operation:
After initial setup, the app works completely offline. Download the AI models once, then enjoy unlimited transcription and organisation without internet connectivity.


Privacy by Design:
- Zero network requests after model download
- No data collection or analytics
- Complete user control over data
